\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}
Our estimator featurizes each predicate.\footnote{Categorical values are hashed.}

\subsection{Model}
We use a multi-set convolutional network with loss $\mathcal{L} = \sum_i (\log \hat{c}_i - \log c_i)^2$.
\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{fig1.pdf}
\caption{Architecture of the {\bf estimator}.}
\end{figure}
\begin{itemize}
\item Tables are one-hot encoded.
\item[Joins] are encoded as edge sets.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Training}
Training queries are sampled from the workload.
